description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy bubble-blower gadget carried on the shoulder, a long chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A long fat round off-white tube lying along the axis. At the front a huge flared trumpet-shaped mid grey horn, far wider than the tube, with a flat bright pink inner face. On top of the tube at the middle a boxy mid grey block on a low grey saddle, with one round bright cyan lens on its front face. Around the rear half of the tube four bright pink rings wrapped round it, evenly spaced. Under the middle of the tube a dark navy handle raked backward, with a bright yellow curved finger lever inside a squarish mid grey loop in front of the handle. In front of that, under the tube, a dark navy front handle shaped like a short upright bar on a small grey bracket. At the rear the tube ends in a wide round mid grey cap, with a round bright cyan canister plugged into it from below, hanging straight down on a short grey neck. A bright yellow lever is on the right flank of the tube.
